name: Beijing Victory Electric Co.,Ltd. Class A
summary: Beijing Victory Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electrical connection products in China. The company offers copper and aluminum rigid conductors, extruded bus bars, injection molded bus bars, epoxy coating bus bars, wind power generators; spring and strap contracts, flexible bus bars, and flexible conductors; automatic guided vehicle charging system and contacts assemblies; heat sinks and clod plates; laminated bus bars and CCS; and rubber medium, epoxy medium, and high voltage cable accessories, fast plug-in-plug, connectors, and rotary transformers. Its products are used in electric power, new energy vehicles, landscape storage, rail transit, and other fields applications. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Tongzhou, China.
